_how_to_use: Corrections for wrong verdicts. After checking a 'Wrong verdict?' report, add the site or sender below with is_safe true or false (reason is optional and shown in the popup). Sites cover their subdomains. Senders can be a domain like github.com (covers its subdomains) or a full address like scammer@gmail.com; free email domains like gmail.com only work as full addresses. A sender marked safe only counts when the email passes the sender check, since anyone can fake the From line. Changes apply right away, no restart needed.

example.com.reason: We've checked example.com by hand, and it's safe.
